prompts.label: Hello Kotlin with Gradle
prompts.text:
I'm new to Kotlin. Set up a minimal JVM project with Gradle Kotlin DSL.

- build.gradle.kts with kotlin jvm plugin and kotlin version
- src/main/kotlin/Main.kt printing Hello Kotlin
- ./gradlew run or application plugin setup
- Explain src layout vs Maven

List files and one run command.

prompts.label: Data class equals copy
prompts.text:
Teach data classes for a beginner.

- data class User(val id: Int, val name: String)
- Auto equals/hashCode/toString demo
- copy() with one field changed
- Contrast with regular class in 3 bullets

Short runnable main function examples.

prompts.label: Null safety operators
prompts.text:
Explain Kotlin null safety with practical examples.

- Nullable String? vs non-null String
- Safe call ?. and Elvis ?: default
- Avoid !! except when justified
- fun parseLength(s: String?): Int example

Beginner-friendly; warn about NPE from Java interop.

prompts.label: Coroutines launch and async
prompts.text:
Introduce coroutines with launch and async.

- runBlocking { } for main demo only
- coroutineScope { launch { delay; println } }
- async/await for parallel fake fetch
- Mention Dispatchers.IO vs Default briefly

Add kotlinx-coroutines dependency snippet.

prompts.label: Flow cold stream basics
prompts.text:
Teach Kotlin Flow for a beginner.

- flow { emit(1); emit(2) } builder
- collect in coroutineScope
- map operator on flow
- Contrast Flow vs List vs Channel in short bullets

Minimal main or suspend function example.

prompts.label: Sealed class when exhaustiveness

prompts.label: Extension functions
prompts.text:

- One extension on nullable type safely

Keep stdlib overlap minimal — custom example.

- Run and curl test
- Mention Ktor for API vs Spring choice briefly

Single Main.kt sketch.

- Explain Room sits on SQLite

No full app — entity/dao/database interfaces only.

- Error handling with try/catch mention

Assume Android or JVM client context.

prompts.label: when expression vs statement
prompts.text:

- Explain composition over inheritance

Short illustrative code.
